annotations.title: Upload an asset to a Meta ad account

description: Upload creative(s) — a finished Hermoso ad OR arbitrary user files (e.g. A folder of media from the user’s desktop) — into a connected ad account’s ASSET LIBRARY so the user or a later ad-build step can use them in their OWN campaigns. Pass `url` for one file, or `urls` (up to 20) to BULK-upload in a single call. Each accepts a public https URL, a data: URI, or a Hermoso /generated path; for LOCAL files call upload_file first and pass the url(s) it returns. Image -> image hash; video -> video id.

kind.description: inferred from the URL if omitted

url.description: a single public https URL / data: URI / /generated path; a URL, not a local file path; use upload_file for local files

urls.description: up to 20 media URLs/paths for a one-call BULK upload

name: upload_meta_asset
title: Upload an asset to a Meta ad account
